# FOCAS Edu

> FOCAS Edu is a practical, exam-oriented Chartered Accountancy (CA) preparation ecosystem, combining personalised coaching (via focasedu.com, based in Trichy, Tamil Nadu) with a self-study "Last Attempt Kit" product line (via kit.focasedu.com, a Shopify storefront) — Question Banks, video-evaluated mock tests, and revision planners for CA Intermediate and CA Final students.

FOCAS Edu's positioning is "Make it Your Last Attempt" — helping CA students clear exams in fewer attempts through focused coaching, ICAI-style test papers with video evaluation, and structured revision systems (Deep FOCAS marathons, MCQ marathons, FOCAS Planner and Manual).

## Coaching (focasedu.com)
- [Home](https://focasedu.com/): Personal CA tutoring — expert-guided sessions, personalised tutor tracking and 100% syllabus coverage, with the course catalogue by level (CA Foundation, CA Intermediate, CA Final).
- [1 Tutor for Every 10 Students](https://focasedu.com/focas): FOCAS Personalised Classes (current batch for the January 2027 attempt) — low student-to-tutor ratio and teaching philosophy.
- [Free Counselling Session](https://focasedu.com/counselling): Book a free one-to-one counselling session on what to study next and how to study next.
- [RTI Answer-Sheet Analysis](https://focasedu.com/rti): Expected 60 but ended up with 39? Analyse your ICAI RTI answer sheets with a mentor and get personalised feedback (Group 1, Group 2 or both).
- [7-Day Auditing Crash Tutoring](https://focasedu.com/audit): Short, intensive crash tutoring for the CA Inter Audit paper.
- [Workout Batch](https://focasedu.com/workout-batch): Solve RTP, MTP and PYP questions with a personal tutor — Group 1, Group 2 and Unit 2D combos.
- [FOCAS Manual](https://focasedu.com/manual): Don't know where to start studying? A structured manual and planner that tells you what to do first.
- [Privacy Policy](https://focasedu.com/privacy-policy.html)
- [Sitemap](https://focasedu.com/sitemap.xml)
